package.description: A free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 11 and 10

en-US.description: A free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 11 and 10
en-US.longDescription:
PecoFence organizes the Windows 11 and 10 desktop into glass fences. Group files and shortcuts
into fences, keep real folders on the desktop as live portals, combine related fences
into tabs, and bring everything above the current application with one shortcut.
Rules file new items automatically, layouts can be snapshotted and restored, and the
interface is available in eleven languages. The bundled pecofence-cli command lets scripts
and AI coding agents read and change fences, rules and settings. Native Rust
application; the Settings window uses the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime that ships
with Windows.
en-US.name: PecoFence
en-US.releaseNotes:
PecoFence 0.3.3 checks for new versions by itself and tells you once when one is out. Everything else is as in 0.3.2, which brought free placement of desktop icons, smart fences, fences for each virtual desktop, filtering in folder fences and type tabs in the Peek search.
Highlights
- Automatic update check. The installer and ZIP editions now look for a new version about a minute after start and then once a day. When one is out, a card in the screen corner says so once, with the first line of that version's notes in your language, Update (it downloads and installs the new version) and What's new; the ZIP edition shows Download. The card waits while a full-screen app, a presentation, the Peek or another card is shown, and closes itself after 30 seconds. Until you update, the tray menu starts with Update to and the version. Settings → About → Check for updates automatically turns it off. Before, a new version showed only when you clicked Check for updates there. The Store edition is updated by the Store.
Fixes
- The cards in the screen corner (feature tips, the rating card and the update card) no longer cover the taskbar's hidden icons, the Start menu or the notification center.
Downloads
- pecofence-v0.3.3-x64-setup.exe: installer, per user, no administrator rights needed.
- pecofence-v0.3.3-x64-portable.zip: portable; extract and run pecofence.exe.
- A .sha256 checksum for each.
Copies installed with the setup can update from Settings → About → Check for updates; from 0.3.3 on, they also tell you by themselves.
Full changelog: v0.3.2...v0.3.3

zh-CN.description: 免费开源的 Windows 11 和 10 桌面整理工具，Stardock Fences 的另一种选择
zh-CN.longDescription:
PecoFence 把 Windows 11 和 10 桌面整理成一个个玻璃栅栏：把文件和快捷方式分组收纳，把真实文件夹作为
门户放在桌面上，把相关栅栏合成标签页，再用一个快捷键把它们全部浮现在当前应用前面。规则可以
自动归类新文件，布局可以保存快照并恢复，界面提供十一种语言。附带的 pecofence-cli 命令让脚本和
AI 编程智能体可以读取和修改栅栏、规则与设置。Rust 编写的原生应用，设置窗口使用
Windows 自带的 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime。
zh-CN.name: PecoFence
